name: Probabilistic Volcanic Hazard Simulations and Exposure Results (Jenkins et al. 2022a, b)
model_or_instrument: Tephra2, LaharZ, ECMapProb (Aravena et al. 2020), large clast model (Rossi et al. 2019)
size_as_stated: 697,080 individual model runs aggregated into 2,280 scenario-based probabilistic hazard footprints

scales.note: Multi-hazard probabilistic simulations (697,080 runs across 40 volcanoes in Indonesia and the Philippines) spanning a regional domain extent up to ~3500 km; grid spacing not stated.
